description:
The Relation Grid (RFC 0050) — the generic Excel-like table primitive
        family. Two DomOpsParty branches merged visually (a layout branch owning
        the td CellSlots; a cells branch owning every ActualCell for its whole
        life), a Relation data model with typed primary keys, and a
        placement-only (i,j) -> (PK, columnName) lookup so view operations are
        pure remaps. Selection re-instantiates the workspace's RFC 0049
        recompute model one level down.

        This module is deliberately its own Maven module (one Crate per module):
        the grid is a reusable primitive family, consumable by any downstream
        without the studio or workspace shells. Phase 1 content: the typed
        contracts (RelationGridContract / GridCellContract /
        RelationAdapterContract) and GridViewMaps — the pure identity/position
        seam, the ONLY place (i,j) meets (PK, columnName).
